mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id AS "kbId", file_name AS "fileName", file_type AS "fileType", file_size AS "fileSize", object_key AS "objectKey", version, parse_status AS "parseStatus", chunk_status AS "chunkStatus", chunk_count AS "chunkCount", error_msg AS "errorMsg", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, kb_id AS "kbId", file_name AS "fileName", file_type AS "fileType", file_size AS "fileSize", version, parse_status AS "parseStatus", chunk_status AS "chunkStatus", chunk_count AS "chunkCount", error_msg AS "errorMsg", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document(kb_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, object_key, uploader_id) VALUES(#{kbId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{objectKey}, #{uploaderId})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, chunk_status = #{chunkStatus}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_document SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
